text:
maya: FYI — weekly hosted spend check-in for AcmeCorp. I see a 45% spike vs their $50k/mo commit this billing week. Flagging for ops.

sam: saw that too. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/acme/spend?range=7d

jordan: timeline? they're mid-onboarding; renewal in 7 weeks. Is this burst expected from test data?

ops-bot: Alert: anomaly_detected: token_count_spike (score: 0.92). Top route: /v1/chat/completions. Spike start: 2024-11-05T02:31:14Z

maya: quick snapshot:
```
commit: $50,000/mo
this week usage: $72,500 (~$18.5k over weekly pro-rata)
delta: +45% vs commit
top 3 routes: /v1/chat/completions (68%), /v1/embeddings (12%), /v1/rerank (8%)
api keys: acme-prod-**** (main), acme-test-zzz (burst)
```

sam: logs show a 6-hr continuous run from `acme-test-zzz`—likely internal stress tests. We should confirm with their engs. Also error rate slightly up: 1.6% 5xx (baseline 0.2%).

jordan: pinged their eng lead (cc @acme-rep) asking if they kicked off load testing. Also suggested turning off test key.

acme-rep: hey team — we did run a scale test yesterday on staging but didn't expect prod key to be used. looking into it now.

eng-ops: we can throttle the test key and roll a new key for them. recommend short-term: rate-limit `acme-test-zzz` to 100rps and apply token cap  max_tokens=1024 per request.

maya: Next steps:
- jordan to confirm with Acme and rotate the test key (due EOD)
- eng-ops to apply throttles and token cap (in 30m)
- cs to monitor spend and errors, escalate if >20% over commit for 3 days

sam: noted. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement to walk them through cost controls and sampling suggestions.

jordan: renewal risk: medium. If they don't accept cost controls, might need to discuss commit adjustment. Will update renewal tracker.

maya: tagging for visibility :eyes: — closing this thread once throttles applied and spending normalizes. :thumbsup:
